en.sayed-ali-raza: [A part of the same sermon :] By Allāh, certainly it is reality not fun, truth not falsehood.
It is none else than death. Its caller is making himself heard and its dragsman is making haste.
The majority of the people should not deceive you.
You have seen those who lived before you, amassed wealth, feared poverty and felt safe from its (evil) consequences, the longerity of desires and the (apparent) distance from death.
How, then, death overtook them, turned them out of their homelands and took them out of their places of safety.
They were borne on coffins, people were busy about them one after another, carrying them on their shoulders and supporting them with their hands.
